title: Patient Communications Schedule for In-Person Appointments
content:
Reminder, confirmation, preparation and interpreter timings for In-Person Appointments are set per visit type as follows.

| Visit type | First reminder (hours before start) | Second reminder (hours before start) | Reminder channel | Coordinator confirmation call | Unconfirmed release (hours before start) | Preparation instructions (days before the visit) | Interpreter request deadline (hours before start) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 72 | 24 | text and email | No | 0 (never released) | 0 (none) | 24 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 72 | 24 | text and email | No | 0 (never released) | 0 (none) | 48 |
| New Patient Office Visit | 72 | 24 | text and email | Yes | 0 (never released) | 2 | 48 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 72 | 24 | text and email | No | 0 (never released) | 3 | 48 |
| Specialist Consultation | 72 | 24 | text and email | Yes | 0 (never released) | 2 | 48 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 168 | 48 | phone call | Yes | 48 | 7 | 72 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 168 | 48 | phone call | Yes | 48 | 3 | 72 |

**Meaning of each column.**

- The first and second reminders go out the stated number of hours before the scheduled start, by the stated channel: text and email, or phone call.
- *Coordinator confirmation call* records whether a scheduling coordinator calls when the patient has not confirmed by the second reminder.
- *Unconfirmed release* is the number of hours before the start by which a still-unconfirmed appointment is released by the clinic; a figure of 0 means the visit type is never released.
- *Preparation instructions* is the number of calendar days before the visit on which preparation instructions are sent; 0 means none are sent.
- *Interpreter request deadline* is the number of hours before the start by which an in-person interpreter must be requested.

**Observations drawn from the table.**

- Only the In-Office Procedure Visit and the Advanced Imaging Appointment are released when unconfirmed, both at 48 hours, and both are reminded by phone call at 168 and 48 hours.
- Preparation instructions are sent 7 days ahead for the In-Office Procedure Visit, 3 days ahead for the Annual Preventive Exam and the Advanced Imaging Appointment, 2 days ahead for the New Patient Office Visit and the Specialist Consultation, and not at all for the Nurse Visit and the Established Patient Office Visit.
